assumptions: The order carried no payload.t0_artifacts[]; the round-2 attempt-1 verdict files were located by convention in .shapeup/todo-cli/t0/verdicts/ and their sha256 recomputed from disk by this judge rather than failing the round for a missing citation list.
The order carried no payload.run_cmd; the app was exercised as `node bin/todo.js <cmd>` from the repo root, which is what package.json bin maps `todo` to.
Every probe ran with HOME pointed at a fresh mktemp -d so the store resolved to an isolated $HOME/.todo.json and the operator's real ~/.todo.json was never read or written.
deviations: Spec defect SD-1: success-message quoting is specified two ways - ux-behavior#done-command/#rm-command say `Done: N) <text>` / `Removed: N) <text>` (unquoted) while UC-CompleteTodo/UC-RemoveTodo System Flow show `Done: "2) buy milk"` / `Removed: "2) buy milk"` (quoted). The build emits the quoted form (bin/todo.js:89, bin/todo.js:121). Not graded as a FAIL because the committed spec contradicts itself; it blocks a clean PASS until one form is chosen.

Spec defect SD-2: the corrupted-store catalog message writes the path literally as `~/.todo.json` while lib/todo-repository.js:50,54 interpolates the resolved absolute path. Graded PASS; the spec should state which is intended.
